text: Malaysian licence plates are **black** and generally have **two** white sections. These are visible even when blurred.
NOTE: Indonesian licence plates can also be black, but they will have **three** white sections.
text_zh: 馬來西亞車牌是**黑色**的，通常有**兩個**白色區塊。即使車牌模糊，這些特徵依然清晰可見。
注意：印尼車牌也可能是黑色的，但它們會有**三個**白色區塊。

text: Malaysia frequently uses **double white** centre lines on its two-lane roads. It is the only Southeast Asian country to do so.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的雙線道公路經常使用**雙白**中心線。它是東南亞唯一這樣做的國家。

text: These **thick yellow bars** are also almost exclusive to Malaysia.
NOTE: You can very rarely see similar patterns in [Hong Kong](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PSUAhJVM8bCQUhH36) and the [United Kingdom](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BKn4346rfTwJj3L26).
text_zh: 這些**粗黃條紋**也幾乎是馬來西亞獨有的。
注意：你極少能在[香港](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PSUAhJVM8bCQUhH36)和[英國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BKn4346rfTwJj3L26)看到類似的圖案。

text: Electricity poles in Malaysia often have **black** or **white** stickers on them.
Sometimes you will also find red-and-white or red-and-blue stripes below the black sticker.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的電線桿通常貼有**黑色**或**白色**貼紙。
parfois 有時你也會在黑色貼紙下方發現紅白相間或紅藍相間的條紋。

text: **BERHENTI** stop signs and **BERI LALUAN** yield signs are both unique to Malaysia.
text_zh: **BERHENTI** 停止標誌與 **BERI LALUAN** 讓路標誌都是馬來西亞特有的。

text: Malaysian bollards will often have the colours **black**, **white**, **grey** and **red**. Here are three examples of typical Malaysian bollards.
NOTE: There can be multiple varieties of these bollards, but the layout is mostly the same.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的路樁通常帶有 **黑色**、**白色**、**灰色** 與 **紅色**。以下是三種典型的馬來西亞路樁範例。
注意：這些路樁可能有多種款式，但配置大致相同。

text: This is a typical Malaysian directional sign. **Hexagonal yellow **highway shields** **are unique to Malaysia.
text_zh: 這是一個典型的馬來西亞方向標誌。**六角形黃色** **高速公路盾牌** 是馬來西亞特有的。

text: Malaysian kilometre markers have a unique **white-and-blue **colour scheme. Note that the hexagon shields are often visible.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的里程碑具有獨特的 **白藍相間** 配色。請注意，通常可以看到六角形盾牌。

text: The **Malay language** uses the Latin script. It is very closely related to Indonesian. These two languages are practically indistinguishable for people who do not speak either.
text_zh: **馬來語** 使用拉丁字母。它與印尼語非常相近。對於不會這兩種語言的人來說，這兩種語言幾乎無法區分。

text: In contrast to neighbouring Indonesia, **Chinese characters** are often seen in Malaysia. In fact, 24.6% of the Malaysian population is of Chinese descent.
text_zh: 與鄰國印尼相比，馬來西亞經常能看到 **中文字**。事實上，馬來西亞有 24.6% 的人口是華裔。

text: Signposts in Malaysia almost always have **black-and-white** **stripes**.
NOTE: Within Asia, these posts are also found in Sri Lanka, Bhutan, India, Nepal and Bangladesh. Make sure to check other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 馬來西亞的路標幾乎總是帶有 **黑白相間** 的 **條紋**。
NOTE: 在亞洲境內，斯里蘭卡、不丹、印度、尼泊爾和孟加拉也能看到這些柱子。在猜測之前，請務必檢查其他線索。

text: **Black-and-white **curbs are commonly found in Malaysia.
NOTE: Many other countries in Asia can also have black-and-white curbs.
text_zh: 馬來西亞常見**黑白相間的**路緣。
NOTE: 亞洲許多其他國家也可能有黑白相間的路緣。

text: Each Malaysian state, excluding the three federal territories, has its own road numbering system with a **unique letter** at the start of the road number.
NOTE: Sabah also has A roads, but only the A2 and A7.
text_zh: 馬來西亞各州（不含三個聯邦直轄區）都有自己的道路編號系統，路號開頭帶有**獨特的字母**。
NOTE: 沙巴也有 A 開頭的道路，但只有 A2 和 A7。

text: **State flags** can be seen with some regularity, so it is worth learning them.
text_zh: 經常可以看到**州旗**，因此很值得學習辨認它們。

text: Malaysian postal codes are useful to know, since they can be found on most street signs in the country.
text_zh: 了解馬來西亞的郵遞區號很有幫助，因為該國的大多數路標上都能找到它們。

text: **Black pole stickers** are most commonly found on the mainland.
NOTE: The black stickers on Borneo only exist in Generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: **黑色電線桿貼紙**最常在馬來半島上找到。
NOTE: 婆羅洲上的黑色貼紙僅存在於第 4 代街景覆蓋中。

text: Black stickers with the text ‘**TEL TNB**’ at the bottom, are only found in Johor.
text_zh: 底部有「**TEL TNB**」字樣的黑色貼紙僅能在柔佛找到。

text: **White pole stickers** are only found on electricity poles on the island of Borneo, in Sarawak.
text_zh: **白色電線桿貼紙**僅在砂拉越婆羅洲島上的電線桿上發現。

text: Lamp posts with **two small circles** on the support are mainly found on mainland Malaysia.
text_zh: 支撐架上有**兩個小圓圈**的路燈主要分佈在馬來半島。

text: Lamp posts with a **triangular metal support** are mainly found on mainland Malaysia.
text_zh: 帶有**三角形金屬支撐架**的路燈主要分佈在馬來半島。

text: Electricity poles on the Borneo side typically have a **2-1 insulator configuration**, and a long **diagonal wooden support**. They are exclusive to the Sarawak region of the island.
NOTE: Indonesian poles can look similar, but they are usually not made of wood, and use smaller or no diagonal supports.
text_zh: 婆羅洲側的電線桿通常具有 **2-1 絕緣子配置**，以及長條的**斜向木質支撐架**。它們是該島砂拉越地區所獨有的。
NOTE: 印尼的電線桿看起來可能很相似，但它們通常不是木製的，且使用較小或沒有斜向支撐架。

text: Thin metal poles with **two parallel **pole tops are exclusive to the Sabah region of Borneo.
text_zh: 帶有**兩個平行**桿頂的細金屬桿是婆羅洲沙巴地區所獨有的。

text: This lamp post with a supporting piece of sheet metal resembling a **boomerang** is found in Sarawak.
NOTE: It is more common in cities other than Kuching.
text_zh: 這個帶有形似**迴力鏢**支撐片金屬的路燈可以在砂拉越找到。
NOTE: 這在古晉以外的城市更為常見。

text: Trash bins with a **logo resembling an ‘S’** are found in the states of Negeri Sembilan, Malacca and Johor.
text_zh: 帶有**形似「S」形標誌**的垃圾桶可以在森美蘭、馬六甲和柔佛州找到。

text: Trash bins with a **logo resembling leaves** are found in Perlis and Kedah.
text_zh: 帶有**形似樹葉標誌**的垃圾桶可以在玻璃市和吉打找到。

text: Trash bins with this logo featuring a **sunny landscape**, saying **‘Alam Flora’** are found in Pahang, Kuala Lumpur and Putrajaya. The logo will occasionally be absent, and it will just say ‘Alam Flora’.
text_zh: 印有**陽光風景**圖案並寫著**「Alam Flora」**字樣的垃圾桶可以在彭亨、吉隆坡和布城找到。這個標誌有時會省略，只寫「Alam Flora」。

text: **Yellow street name signs** with a black outline are specific to the state of Johor.
NOTE: This **arrow-shaped** street sign, regardless of its colour, is exclusive to Malaysia.
NOTE: Yellow signs are also found in southern [Negeri Sembilan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HG89SePzMd5WWheo6), however only the tip of the arrow will be black.
text_zh: 帶有黑色外框的**黃色路名標誌**是柔佛州特有的。
NOTE: 這個**箭頭形狀**的路標，無論其顏色為何，都是馬來西亞特有的。
NOTE: 黃色標誌也見於[森美蘭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HG89SePzMd5WWheo6)南部，不過只有箭頭的尖端是黑色的。

text: **Green** street signs that form an arrow shape and have a **yellow hexagonal symbol **with the letters** JKR** on the left side are found in Sabah.
text_zh: 呈現箭頭形狀且左側有帶有 **JKR** 字樣的**黃色六角形符號**的**綠色**路名牌可以在沙巴找到。

text: Assuming you are on Borneo: the state of Sabah is **very mountainous**, and much of the coverage is on mountain roads like this one.
NOTE: Sarawak generally has flatter roads. Even if you see mountains, they will usually be at a [distance](https://goo.gl/maps/5VrnWWJCBfNgREaP7).
text_zh: 假設你在婆羅洲：沙巴州**非常多山**，且大部分的街景都在像這樣的山路上。
注意：砂勞越的道路通常較平坦。就算你看到山，通常也都在[遠處](https://goo.gl/maps/5VrnWWJCBfNgREaP7)。

text: These **isolated rock formations**, rising abruptly from an otherwise flat landscape, can be found near the Thai border in Perlis state.
text_zh: 這些**孤立的岩層**從平坦的地景中拔地而起，可以在玻璃市州的泰國邊境附近找到。

text: Urban areas in Labuan are dotted with **blue cylindrical containers**.
text_zh: 納閩的市區散落著**藍色圓柱形容器**。

text: This unique **grey car** with a long front antenna can be found in Gunung Mulu National Park, Sarawak.
text_zh: 這個獨特的**灰色車**配有長前天線，可以在砂勞越的姆魯山國家公園找到。
